SWORD.name: Sword
SWORD.desc: Close work. A lunge that cuts everything on its line; melee flows hit far harder, and bolts leave the blade sluggish.

GUN.name: Gun
GUN.desc: Range and speed. Bolts fly flat and fast; the stock makes a poor club.

ROCK.name: Rock
ROCK.desc: One stone, thrown with everything built into it. It lands where it lands, and does nothing more until you pick it up.

RUNE.name: Rune
RUNE.desc: A stone with a charge stored in it, thrown as the rock is: the throw goes out charged, and costs you nothing. Thrown, it is spent, and does nothing until you hold the cast button with it in hand to pour your own mana back in.

SHOVEL.name: Shovel
SHOVEL.desc: A spade for a blade: it swings like anything heavy, and it digs. Hold the use key on lit ground to bring up what is buried there — loudly.

SHURIKEN.name: Shuriken
SHURIKEN.desc: A stack of throwing stars, thrown with everything built into them. Each flies flat and true and sticks where it strikes; walk over one to take it back.

HAND.name: Empty hand
HAND.desc: Nothing in it but a fist: what the hand casts is a graph of punches.
